idea-plugin.name: Oracle JDK License Check and Temurin Fixer
idea-plugin.description:
New Oracle JDK 21 updates are no longer free for production from 20 October 2026. Oracle's Java SE Support Roadmap: "Updates of JDK 21 released beginning with the October 2026 Critical Patch Update (CPU), are planned to be offered under the Java SE OTN license" — and the October 2026 Critical Patch Update is on 20 October 2026 (Java SE Support Roadmap · Oracle Critical Patch Updates, both read 2026-10-11). Open your project and the Java map shows, file and line, every place that still pulls an Oracle JDK build before that day.

Moving off the Oracle JDK to Eclipse Temurin (Adoptium) or another OpenJDK build? This finds every place your project pulls an Oracle-licensed Java build and rewrites it to the free Temurin line — GitHub Actions setup-java, Dockerfile base images, Gradle toolchains (JvmVendorSpec.ORACLE), dev containers, Homebrew and winget — and tells you exactly what to do for the lines that need a human choice (SDKMAN, asdf / mise, Maven toolchains, Oracle Linux rpm installs, download URLs).

The dates, from Oracle's own pages: Oracle JDK 21 releases through September 2026 are under the No-Fee Terms (NFTC); updates from the October 2026 Critical Patch Update (20 October 2026) are under the Java SE OTN license. Oracle JDK 17 updates released from 15 October 2024 are OTN; Oracle JDK 8 and 11 builds are OTN (personal, development and test use). Oracle prices the Java SE Universal Subscription on total headcount, contractors included.

  • Java map (free): Tools → Oracle JDK License Check: Java Map. Every place this project chooses a Java build, the JDKs this IDE runs it on (read from each JDK's own release file), and the Temurin / Corretto line for each place.
  • Inline check (free): 18 rules on Dockerfiles, CI workflows, Gradle and Maven files, SDKMAN, asdf and shell scripts, as you open them. Each finding names the license and the free line that replaces it.
  • Fix This File (free): rewrites the Oracle lines in the file you have open to Temurin, in one undo step.
  • Fix All in Project + migration record (Pro, JetBrains Marketplace licence): rewrites every Oracle line across the whole project in one step and writes a dated record next to the project — every line changed (before / after), every line that still needs a choice, the JDKs the IDE knows and the SHA-256 of every file read — for your team lead, an auditor or CI.

Runs inside the IDE: no Node.js, nothing leaves your machine. If usage statistics sharing is on in the IDE, one anonymous count per action (tool name and action only, never file content); set READYSTACK_NO_TELEMETRY=1 to turn it off. This plugin states what your files say on a date; it is not legal advice. Oracle and Java are registered trademarks of Oracle and/or its affiliates; this plugin is not affiliated with Oracle.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.1 — keeps working in IntelliJ-based IDEs 2025.3 and newer: the licence dialog now opens through the current IntelliJ Platform action API (the old call is scheduled for removal). No change to what the plugin checks.

1.3.0: The date is now Oracle's own: new Oracle JDK 21 updates move to the Java SE OTN license at the Critical Patch Update of 20 October 2026 (Java SE Support Roadmap · Oracle Critical Patch Updates, read 2026-10-11) — findings count down to that day, and the Java map and the dated record cite both pages. Oracle JDK 17: OTN since 15 October 2024. Renamed to Oracle JDK License Check and Temurin Fixer.

1.2.0: Fix This File (free) rewrites the Oracle JDK lines in the open file to Eclipse Temurin. Fix All in Project plus a dated migration record is now the Pro part, sold through JetBrains Marketplace (the Java map and the inline check stay free). Renamed to Oracle JDK to Temurin Fixer.

1.1.0: Java map. The checks run inside the IDE with no Node.js. 18 rules.
